jobs.title: On-Site Federal Security Manager - Data Center Operations Lead
jobs.description:
QTS Realty Trust is seeking a Federal Security Manager I to provide a visible, on-site security presence across a data center facility in Fort Worth, TX. The role ensures safe operations, enforces security policies, manages access control, CCTV, and incident response, and supports audits and reporting.

Responsibilities include supervising contracted security staff, coordinating with law enforcement, conducting training, and maintaining safety drills and emergency plans in a 24x7 environment.

jobs.title: Federal Security Lead – Onsite Data Center Security
jobs.description:
Quality Technology Services, LLC in Fort Worth, TX is seeking a Federal Security Manager I to oversee on-site security for a 24x7 data center environment. This role reports to the Regional Manager, Federal Security and supports compliance with National Industrial Security Program and government regulations.

The position requires on-site work, frontline supervision of security staff, and dynamic incident response, access control, CCTV, and audits.

jobs.title: Entry-Level Security Rep - Federal Programs & Clearances
jobs.description: Lockheed Martin is seeking an experienced Security Representative to support the Integrated Fighter Group for the F-22 Program. This role involves executing security requirements, conducting briefings, and maintaining effective communication with various stakeholders. Qualified candidates must have knowledge of security regulations and possess a Final Secret Clearance. The position offers flexible work schedules and is located in Fort Worth, Texas.
